# Fainica Consultancy

> Creative consultancy in Middelburg, Mpumalanga, working countrywide. Three main services: interior styling (also called interior design), content creation (styling, shooting, creative direction) and event co-ordination. Founded in 2025 by Faith Malesoena and Duduzile Monica Mncube.

## Services
- [Services overview](https://fainicaconsultancy.co.za/services): the three main services and what each includes
- [Interior styling](https://fainicaconsultancy.co.za/interior-styling): room styling, décor sourcing, mural painting, commercial spaces
- [Content creation](https://fainicaconsultancy.co.za/content-creation): photoshoot styling, photography and video, creative direction, brand visuals, wardrobe styling
- [Event co-ordination](https://fainicaconsultancy.co.za/event-coordination): planning, venue décor, supplier sourcing, day-of co-ordination

## About and work
- [About](https://fainicaconsultancy.co.za/about): the team, how we work and why clients choose us
- [Portfolio](https://fainicaconsultancy.co.za/portfolio): project photography across all three services

## Articles
- [How to Create a Beautiful and Balanced Home: Simple Interior Styling Tips](https://fainicaconsultancy.co.za/article-interior-styling-tips): Practical interior styling (interior design) tips on colour, texture, furniture and lighting from Fainica Consultancy, to help you create a balanced and inviting home.
- [How to Build a Versatile Wardrobe: Simple Styling Tips for Everyday Confidence](https://fainicaconsultancy.co.za/article-wardrobe-styling-tips): Simple wardrobe styling tips from Fainica Consultancy: essentials, colour combinations, layering, accessories and planning your outfits ahead.
- [How to Create Engaging Social Media Content for Your Business](https://fainicaconsultancy.co.za/article-social-media-content): Practical tips from Fainica Consultancy on creating social media content for your business: purpose, phone photography, visual identity and planning.
- [How to Plan a Stress-Free Event: Simple Event Co-ordination Tips](https://fainicaconsultancy.co.za/article-event-coordination-tips): Simple event co-ordination tips from Fainica Consultancy: set your purpose and budget, build a timeline, and style the details so the day runs smoothly.
